description: TemoaProject: Substitution between Energy Efficiency and Electricity in an Energy System Optimization Model is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Neha Patankar, Harrison Fell (NC State University). This zenodo archive includes the Temoa code and data used to produce the publication by Patankar et al. (2020) titled "Substitution between Energy Efficiency and Electricity in an Energy System Optimization Model." Tools for Energy Model Optimization and Analysis (Temoa) is an open source energy system model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL-2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
